pr_title: Adding support to supply custom connection manager
pr_body:
Adding  a provision to plugin a Connection manager, this is will open up possibilities to write custom cloud provider specific connection manager. 
My intention is to auto discover, and auto scale Clients for AWS elasticache with AWS specific codebase, like calling AWS ElastiCache API periodically. Similar to ReplicatedServerConnection Manager, but this depends on ElastiCache API instead if INFO Replication.
pr_comments: @SaikiranDaripelli Just wondering, are you going to contribute your AWS Connection Manager into Redisson?
I can, and have working code ready, but since this library does not have any direct cloud provider dependency was holding back.
You can do it the same way as this PR
@mrniko Did you get chance to look at the code, i am hoping if atleast first commit can reach 3.3.2 then i need not setup build for the fork on my side.

issue_context.title: Is there any way to provide/plugin connection manager
issue_context.body:
Hi,
   Currently i am trying to plugin a Connection manager and config which can auto-discover nodes in AWS ElastiCache calling an AWS api, Current ReplicatedServersConfig is limited, where in it cannot add/remove newly added/removed slaves automatically and it needs me to configure individual node addresses instead of configuration endpoint.
But i see that ConfigSupport.createConnectionManager is static method. is there any way to plugin new connection manager?

review_comments: @SaikiranDaripelli  Can't it use internal client object?

For using internal client, we need to support various ways for providing aws credentials and different users have different preferences on how to supply aws key and secret.
http://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-java/v1/developer-guide/credentials.html#credentials-default.
And some organisations use their preferred KMS systems apart from above defaults.  i thought it would be simpler if they can supply the client created as per their preferred method.
